examples.en: Your name came up in the planning meeting — in a good way.
examples.zh: 你的名字在规划会上被提到了，是好事。

entries.note: come up 也有“出现（问题、机会）”的意思：Something has come up. 我有点急事（脱身常用句）。

situation.en: Something urgent has come up, so I'll have to reschedule our call.
situation.zh: 同事临时约你开会，你想说有点急事要改时间。

entries.zh: 被提起；（事情）突然出现

examples.en: I only found out about the API change when my code broke.
examples.zh: 我是代码报错了才发现接口改了。

entries.note: 和 figure out 的区别：find out 是从外部得知事实，figure out 是自己推导出来。

situation.en: Let me find out who owns that service and get back to you.
situation.zh: 同事问某个服务谁负责，你说你去打听一下。

entries.zh: 查明、得知（一个事实）

examples.en: Half the team did not turn up to the workshop.
examples.zh: 团队有一半人没来参加研讨会。

entries.note: turn up 还可以是“把音量调大”，以及“（丢失的东西）被找到”：The keys turned up in my jacket。

situation.en: Just turn up at the office around nine and ask for Sarah.
situation.zh: 你约了个来访者，告诉他直接来就行。

entries.zh: 出现、露面（人或丢失的东西）

examples.en: You should check out the new profiling tool — it found our leak in minutes.
examples.zh: 你该试试那个新的性能分析工具，它几分钟就找出了我们的内存泄漏。

situation.en: Check out the internal wiki page I sent you — it covers the whole setup.
situation.zh: 你想给同事指个内部文档让他去看看。

entries.zh: 去看看、了解一下（推荐别人去看的说法）

examples.en: We are trying out a new code review process for two weeks.
examples.zh: 我们正在试行一套新的代码评审流程，为期两周。

situation.en: Let's try out the new dashboard with one team first.
situation.zh: 你提议先小范围试用新仪表盘。

entries.zh: 试用、试行（新方法或工具）

examples.en: She put together a short demo for the stakeholders in one afternoon.
examples.zh: 她用一个下午就拼出了一个给干系人看的简短演示。

situation.en: I'll put together a one-pager with the options and trade-offs.
situation.zh: 评审前你答应整理一份方案对比出来。

entries.zh: 拼凑、整理出（文档、演示、方案）

examples.en: Set aside Friday afternoons for refactoring, or it will never happen.
examples.zh: 把周五下午留出来做重构，不然永远也轮不到。

situation.en: Let's set aside an hour next week to plan the migration.
situation.zh: 你提议专门留一小时讨论迁移计划。

entries.zh: 留出（时间、资源）专门做某事

examples.en: Always write down the assumptions in the design doc — future you will thank you.
examples.zh: 一定要把假设写进设计文档，未来的你会感谢现在的你。

situation.en: Let me write that down before I forget.
situation.zh: 开会时对方说了一个重要细节，你想记下来。

entries.zh: 写下来、记下来

examples.en: Please fill out the access request form before Friday.
examples.zh: 请在周五前把权限申请表填好。

entries.note: fill out 是填整张表，fill in 是填某个空或替某人班。美式口语里两者常混用。

situation.en: It takes two minutes to fill out, just your team and the systems you need.
situation.zh: 新同事问申请表要填什么，你告诉他很简单。

entries.zh: 填写（整张表格）

examples.en: I need to hand in my timesheet before the end of the month.
examples.zh: 我得在月底前把工时表交上去。

situation.en: We hand in the report on Mondays, so Friday is our writing day.
situation.zh: 向新同事介绍团队的周报节奏。

entries.zh: 上交、提交（作业、报表、申请）

examples.en: Anyone can start a refactor; following through is the hard part.
examples.zh: 谁都能起头做重构，难的是坚持做完。

situation.en: We agreed on the plan last week — now we need to follow through.
situation.zh: 复盘时你说计划定了就得执行到底。

entries.zh: 把（承诺、计划）贯彻到底

examples.en: He threatened to resign twice but never went through with it.
examples.zh: 他两次扬言要辞职，但都没真的走。

situation.en: Are we really going through with the data center move?
situation.zh: 你想确认那个大动作是不是真的要执行。

entries.zh: 把（已经决定的事）真正做完、执行到底

examples.en: After two hours of debugging, I gave up and asked for a second pair of eyes.
examples.zh: 调了两小时之后我放弃了，找了个人一起看。

entries.note: give up 后面接动名词：give up guessing。也有积极用法：give up a bad habit 戒掉坏习惯。

situation.en: Don't give up on the migration yet — the hard part is done.
situation.zh: 队友想放弃迁移，你给他打气。

entries.zh: 放弃（不做了）

examples.en: The vendor backed out of the deal a week before signing.
examples.zh: 签约前一周，供应商反悔退出了。

situation.en: It's fine to back out now; it's much worse after we announce it.
situation.zh: 同事拿不准要不要退出一个承诺，你给他台阶。

entries.zh: 反悔、退出（已经答应的事）

examples.en: You can count on the platform team — they always deliver on time.
examples.zh: 平台组靠得住，他们从来都是按时交付。

situation.en: Count on me for the release notes, I'll draft them tonight.
situation.zh: 你想跟同事保证这件事包在你身上。

entries.zh: 指望、信赖（某人某事靠得住）

examples.en: This bug fix took up my entire morning.
examples.zh: 这个 bug 修复占了我一整个早上。

entries.note: take up 还可以是“开始（爱好）”：take up running。靠宾语区分。

situation.en: The migration will take up most of next sprint.
situation.zh: 规划会上你提醒迁移要占掉大部分时间。

entries.zh: 占用（时间、空间）；开始（爱好）

examples.en: We just need to get through this release, then things will calm down.
examples.zh: 我们只要熬过这次发布，后面就轻松了。

situation.en: Rough week, but we'll get through it.
situation.zh: 队友这周很惨，你安慰他能挺过去。

entries.zh: 熬过、完成（一段难熬的时期或大量工作）

examples.en: I stayed up until three fixing the certificate issue.
examples.zh: 我熬夜到三点修证书的问题。

situation.en: I stayed up too late last night, so I'm running on coffee today.
situation.zh: 早上你跟同事解释自己为什么没精神。

entries.zh: 熬夜不睡

examples.en: On Sundays I sleep in and do absolutely nothing before ten.
examples.zh: 周日我睡懒觉，十点前什么都不干。

situation.en: Sleep in tomorrow — we moved standup to ten.
situation.zh: 你告诉同事明天站会推迟了，可以多睡会儿。

entries.zh: 睡懒觉、睡过头（褒义的赖床）

examples.en: It took the team weeks to get over the failed launch.
examples.zh: 发布失败之后，团队花了几周才缓过来。

entries.note: get over 也常指病好了：get over a cold。也指“忘掉某人”：get over an ex。

situation.en: I'll get over it — I just need a quiet weekend.
situation.zh: 同事问你被拒的事还难受吗，你说缓缓就好。

entries.zh: 从（打击、疾病）中恢复过来

examples.en: Could you speak up? The people at the back cannot hear you.
examples.zh: 你能大声一点吗？后面的人听不见。

entries.note: speak up 还可以是“勇敢发表意见”：Nobody spoke up in the meeting。两个意思都高频。

situation.en: Please speak up if you see a problem with the plan.
situation.zh: 你鼓励团队在会上直言。

entries.zh: 大声点；有意见就直说

examples.en: Sorry I missed your call — I will call you back after this meeting.
examples.zh: 抱歉没接到你电话，会后我给你回过去。

situation.en: Drop me a message and I'll call back within the hour.
situation.zh: 你让来访者留言，你保证一小时内回电。

entries.zh: 回电话

examples.en: Two hundred people signed up for the internal beta in the first day.
examples.zh: 内测第一天就有两百人报名。

situation.en: Did you sign up for the conference yet? Early birds end Friday.
situation.zh: 你提醒同事大会的早鸟票快截止了。

entries.zh: 报名、注册参加

examples.en: We have three interviews lined up for Thursday afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四下午已经安排了三场面试。

entries.note: line up 名词是 lineup（阵容、排期）。人排队也可以用 line up，美式更常用，英式多说 queue up。

situation.en: I have a few candidates lined up for the design review.
situation.zh: 你跟经理说评审的人选已经排好了。

entries.zh: 安排好、排好（人选、日程）；排队

examples.en: Feel free to drop by my desk if the setup gives you trouble.
examples.zh: 要是环境配置出问题，尽管来我工位找我。

situation.en: I'll drop by around four to pick up the form.
situation.zh: 你告诉同事你四点左右顺路过去。

entries.zh: 顺路过来看看（短暂停留）

examples.en: They turned down my proposal to rewrite the billing service.
examples.zh: 他们拒绝了我重写计费服务的提议。

entries.note: turn down 也指把声音、温度调小：turn down the music。靠宾语区分。

situation.en: He turned down the offer because the role was mostly meetings.
situation.zh: 你解释朋友为什么没接那个 offer。

entries.zh: 拒绝（提议、offer）；调小

examples.en: We had to call off the team outing because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雨，我们不得不取消团建。

situation.en: Let's call off today's deploy — the vendor status is still red.
situation.zh: 你提议取消今天的发布。

entries.zh: 取消（已经安排好的活动）

examples.en: Please shut down your laptop before swapping the battery.
examples.zh: 换电池前请先关机。

entries.note: 名词 shutdown 是一个词：a government shutdown。口语说关机也常用 turn off，shut down 更正式一点。

situation.en: We'll shut down the old cluster at the end of the month.
situation.zh: 你在群里通知旧集群的下线时间。

entries.zh: 关闭、关停（机器、系统、服务）

examples.en: Users can opt in to the beta from the settings page.
examples.zh: 用户可以在设置页选择加入测试版。

situation.en: The new analytics are opt-in, so nothing changes unless you turn them on.
situation.zh: 你在评审时强调新统计是自愿开启的。

entries.zh: 选择加入（自愿开启某功能）

examples.en: Most users never opt out of the weekly digest.
examples.zh: 大多数用户从不退订每周摘要。

situation.en: You can opt out anytime from the link in the email footer.
situation.zh: 你向用户说明退订方式。

entries.zh: 选择退出、退订

examples.en: The feature really took off once we added sharing.
examples.zh: 加上分享功能之后，这个功能真的火起来了。

entries.note: take off 三个高频义：飞机起飞、（产品）走红、请假一天（take a day off）。

situation.en: I need to take off early on Friday for a family thing.
situation.zh: 你跟经理说周五要早走一会儿。

entries.zh: （飞机）起飞；（产品）迅速走红；请假离开

examples.en: I messed up the deploy script and rolled back the wrong release.
examples.zh: 我把发布脚本搞砸了，还回滚错了版本。

situation.en: I messed up the time zones on the invites — sorry, fixing now.
situation.zh: 你在群里承认会议邀请的时区弄错了。

entries.zh: 搞砸、弄乱

examples.en: We ate out every night during the conference week.
examples.zh: 开会那周我们每天晚上都在外面吃。

situation.en: Let's eat out tonight — I don't feel like cooking.
situation.zh: 你跟家人商量今晚出去吃。

entries.zh: 出去吃、在餐馆吃

examples.en: The prototype is a dead end — let's scrap it and start over.
examples.zh: 这个原型走不通，推倒重来吧。

situation.en: If the numbers look wrong, start over from the raw data.
situation.zh: 你指导新人怎么处理算错的数据。

entries.zh: 从头开始、重来

examples.en: The retro is over — let's fix what we can and move on.
examples.zh: 复盘结束了，能改的改，然后翻篇吧。

situation.en: We've spent enough time on this topic; let's move on to the roadmap.
situation.zh: 会议主持时你想切换到下一个议题。

entries.zh: 翻篇、往前走；进入下一个（议题）

examples.en: You do not have to put up with a broken build for a week.
examples.zh: 你没必要忍受构建坏掉一星期。

situation.en: I won't put up with last-minute scope changes anymore.
situation.zh: 一对一时你表明态度：不再接受临时改需求。

entries.zh: 忍受（不合理的人或事）

examples.en: The old tool let us down right in the middle of the busiest week.
examples.zh: 最忙的那周，那个老工具掉链子了。

entries.note: let down 语气比 disappoint 温和，多用于口语和工具“不给力”。

situation.en: Sorry to let you down — the fix needs one more day.
situation.zh: 你要向同事道歉：交付得推迟一天。

entries.zh: 让（某人）失望；关键时刻掉链子

examples.en: Can you fill in for me on the support rotation next Tuesday?
examples.zh: 下周二的支持轮值你能替我一下吗？

situation.en: I'll fill in for Anna while she's on leave.
situation.zh: 你在站会上说你来顶休假同事的班。

entries.zh: 替（某人）顶班、代班

examples.en: We finally got rid of the old reporting system last quarter.
examples.zh: 上个季度我们终于把旧报表系统扔掉了。

situation.en: Let's get rid of these flaky tests instead of retrying them forever.
situation.zh: 你提议删掉不稳定的测试而不是一直重试。

entries.zh: 摆脱、去掉（讨厌的东西）

examples.en: We are cutting down on meetings to protect focus time.
examples.zh: 我们在减少会议，保护专注时间。

situation.en: I need to cut down on coffee — three cups is my limit now.
situation.zh: 你跟同事开玩笑说咖啡要减量了。

entries.zh: 减少（数量、频率）
